sentences.text:
THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The petitioners have been charge sheeted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323,
504, 506, 363 read with Section 149 of IPC read with Sections 3 and 4 of DP Act.
2. The petitioner - accused No.1 is the husband of respondent No.1 - defacto complainant.
The accused No.8 is the uncle of accused No.1 and the accused No.11 is the friend of accused No.1.
It is alleged that they subjected the defacto complainant to cruelty both mentally and physically.

3. The parties are before this Court and they have filed the affidavits respectively stating that, they have amicably settled the dispute among themselves at the instance of well wishers, and have continued to lead cordial marital life.
4. The affidavits are placed on record.
NC: 2023:KHC-K:887 5.

Though the offences alleged against the petitioners - accused are cognizable and non-compoundable, however, having regard to the fact that, the parties have settled the dispute among themselves, and the defacto complainant is having no objection for quashing the impugned proceeding, it would be a futile exercise if the petitioners - accused herein are subjected to trial, since the probability of conviction of the petitioners - accused herein is remote and bleak in view of the settlement arrived.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
